findings.description: This accepted answer omits the required comma before pero connecting two clauses. The policy permits optional final punctuation, not omission of an internal comma.
findings.suggestion: Remove v2 or replace it with a correctly punctuated variant such as "Yo estoy cansado, pero trabajo."

sources: RAE/ASALE, Diccionario panhispánico de dudas, entry «coma», use before adversative coordinated clauses introduced by pero (from memory).
